evidence_summary: NRG1 stimulation was tested in cells expressing ERBB2/ERBB3; receptor heterodimerization and reciprocal receptor phosphorylation were directly measured, with ERBB3 identified as the ligand-binding partner and ERBB2 as the kinase partner.

evidence_summary: NRG1 stimulation was tested in cells expressing ERBB2/ERBB4; heterodimerization and receptor phosphorylation were directly measured, including ERBB2 trans-phosphorylation by ERBB4.
